programme.title: O Homem Do Tai Chi
programme.desc: O talento sem paralelo para o Tai Chi de um jovem perito em artes marciais vale-lhe a entrada num clube de combate do submundo altamente lucrativo.

programme.title: Peppermint
programme.desc: Riley North acorda de um coma após o assassinato do seu marido e da sua filha num brutal ataque à sua família. Quando o sistema protege os assassinos da justiça, Riley transforma-se numa verdadeira guerrilheira urbana, aplicando de forma metódica a sua forma muito pessoal de justiça.

programme.title: Domino - A Hora Da Vingança
programme.desc: Um polícia de Copenhaga procura fazer justiça pela morte de um colega que foi assassinado por um homem misterioso.

programme.title: Extremamente Perverso, Escandalosamente Cruel E Vil
programme.desc: Ted é um homem bonito, inteligente e afetuoso. Liz é uma mãe solteira, cautelosa, mas apaixonada. Imagem da felicidade doméstica, a vida deste casal parece perfeita até ele ser preso e acusado de vários assassínios tenebrosos. Ele é Ted Bundy e torna-se o serial-killer mais famoso da América.

programme.title: Send It Uma História Radical
programme.desc: A vida de um praticante de desportos radicais muda para sempre ao deixar as suas simples raízes do Texas para competir no campeonato de kiteboarding mais prestigiado do mundo. Ao longo do caminho, uma jovem vai desafiá-lo a ir muito para lá da sua zona de conforto.

programme.title: Um Mercado De Milhões
programme.desc: O futebol dos nossos dias é uma indústria global onde estão em jogo milhares de milhões de euros. Driss Berzane é um agente de jogadores à beira da falência, que tem apenas sete dias até ao encerramento do mercado de transferências para conseguir pagar uma dívida de 300 mil euros.

programme.title: Mascarade
programme.desc: Quando um jovem gigolo se apaixona por uma irresistível vigarista, um esquema desonesto é concebido à luz do sol escaldante da Côte dAzur. Na busca de uma vida de luxo, irão os dois amantes tão longe a ponto de sacrificar o sustento de um agente imobiliário e de uma estrela de cinema reformada

programme.title: Decisão De Partir
programme.desc: Um homem morre após cair de uma montanha na Coreia do Sul. O detetive Hae-joon investiga o caso e suspeita da enigmática viúva, Seo-rae, mas acaba por se apaixonar por ela, ficando dividido entre o dever profissional e uma perigosa paixão.

programme.title: Ousadas E Golpistas
programme.desc: Um grupo de strippers de Nova Iorque droga os homens de negócios de Wall Street que visitam o clube e depois rouba-lhes dinheiro do cartão de crédito, sabendo que eles não poderão ir à polícia sem denunciar que lá estiveram. Só que a prática alastra-se e o perigo torna-se muito real.

programme.title: Regresso Ao Futuro Parte III
programme.desc: Preso em 1955, Marty tem de viajar até ao Velho Oeste de 1885 para salvar Doc Brown de um fim prematuro. Só que o cientista apaixonou-se por uma encantadora professora e só Marty poderá resolver a situação e trazê-los para o presente sãos e salvos.

programme.title: Eliminators Fugir Ou Morrer
programme.desc: Um antigo agente federal tem de abandonar o programa de proteção de testemunhas quando a sua casa é invadida por engano. Quando volta a ser perseguido por um perigoso assassino, tem de fugir com a filha e garantir a sua segurança antes de ser apanhado

programme.title: Conspiração Terrorista
programme.desc: Alice Racine é uma agente da CIA não conseguiu evitar um ataque terrorista que dizimou dezenas de vítimas e que é forçada a voltar à ação para tentar neutralizar um brutal ataque ao território britânico com uma arma biológica.

programme.title: Academia De Polícia 4 A Patrulha Do Cidadão
programme.desc: O pelotão de desastrados da Academia de Polícia tem por missão treinar no combate ao crime um novo grupo de voluntários civis, só que o Capitão Harris vai faze de tudo para sabotar o novo programa.

programme.title: Ava
programme.desc: Ava é uma assassina a soldo de uma organização secreta, que viaja por todo mundo com a missão de abater alvos VIP. Quando um desses trabalhos corre mal, Ava é obrigada a lutar pela sua sobrevivência e a enfrentar os fantasmas do passado

programme.title: O Corpo Da Mentira
programme.desc: Roger Ferris é um agente da CIA que descobre que um grande líder terrorista opera a partir da Jordânia. Quando concebe um plano para se infiltrar na sua rede, começa a questionar se os seus aliados não poderão interferir na operação e pôr a sua vida em risco.

programme.title: Homefront - A Última Defesa
programme.desc: Um ex-agente do departamento de combate à droga muda-se com a filha para uma pequena cidade rural em busca de uma vida tranquila. Quando um conflito escolar expõe o seu passado, ele atrai a atenção de um perigoso traficante local que ameaça a sua família.

programme.title: Tom Of Finland
programme.desc: A vida e obra do artista finlandês Touko Valio Laaksonen, mais conhecido como Tom of Finland, uma das figuras mais influentes e celebradas da cultura gay do século XX, desde o seu regresso a casa após lutar na Segunda Guerra Mundial até à sua consagração por via dos seus desenhos homoeróticos.

programme.title: A Melhor História De Paulo Coelho
programme.desc: Com base em depoimentos do próprio Paulo Coelho, o filme conta a história dos momentos mais marcantes da vida do escritor, como os traumas, a relação com as drogas e a religião, a sexualidade e a parceria com o músico Raul Seixas.

programme.title: Os Medos De Rain
programme.desc: Uma rapariga que vive com esquizofrenia luta com alucinações terríveis quando começa a suspeitar que o seu vizinho sequestrou uma criança. A única pessoa que acredita nela é Caleb, um miúdo que ela nem tem a certeza de que existe.

programme.title: Todo O Dinheiro Do Mundo
programme.desc: Quando o neto de 16 anos do homem mais rico do mundo, John Paul Getty, é raptado, a família recebe um pedido de resgate exorbitante, que o milionário se recusa a pagar. Com a vida do filho em jogo, Gail alia-se ao braço direito de Getty para tentar resolver a situação.

programme.title: Hotel Mumbai
programme.desc: Esta é a história do ataque terrorista ao luxuoso Taj Mahal Palace Hotel, em Bombaim, no ano de 2008. No meio do caos, os funcionários do hotel arriscam a vida para manterem todos a salvo e fazem sacrifícios impensáveis para se protegerem a si e às suas famílias.

programme.title: À Deriva
programme.desc: Quando Tami e Richard, um casal de ávidos velejadores, se aventuram numa viagem pelo oceano, são atingidos por um furacão devastador. Após a tempestade, ela encontra-o gravemente ferido e o barco quase destruído, e vai ter de encontrar as forças necessárias para os salvar.

programme.title: First Kill Caça Ao Homem
programme.desc: Will Beeman é um bem sucedido profissional de Wall Street cujo filho é raptado. Para resgatar o rapaz, ele terá ajudar o raptor a recuperar a chave que dá acesso ao dinheiro roubado num banco, sempre perseguido pelo chefe da polícia Marvin Howell.

programme.title: Assalto Ao Shopping
programme.desc: Eddie Deacon é um ex-militar que só consegue arranjar emprego como segurança de supermercado. Logo na primeira noite, tem de proteger uma menina que é atacada por mercenários profissionais para a impedirem de testemunhar contra eles.

programme.title: Um Polícia No Jardim Escola 2
programme.desc: Com a missão de recuperar informação sensível que foi roubada, um agente do FBI com mau feitio faz-se passar por professor do jardim de infância, mas o ambiente liberal e politicamente correto da escola torna-se cada vez mais insuportável para ele.

programme.title: Utoya, 22 De Julho
programme.desc: Uma rapariga adolescente tenta sobreviver e encontrar a irmã mais nova durante o massacre de 22 de Julho de 2011 na ilha norueguesa de Utoya, quando um terrorista de extrema-direita atirou a matar às centenas jovens que ali participavam num campo de férias político.

programme.title: Os Miseráveis
programme.desc: Stéphane é um polícia que se muda da província para os subúrbios de Paris, onde se junta à Brigada Anti-Crime e descobre rapidamente o clima de extrema tensão que existe entre os diferentes gangues locais e as forças da ordem.

programme.title: Hell Or High Water - Custe O Que Custar
programme.desc: Um pai divorciado e seu irmão mais velho, um ex-condenado, recorrem a um plano desesperado de assalto a bancos para salvar a fazenda da sua família no Oeste do Texas.

programme.title: O Assassinato De Nicole Brown Simpson
programme.desc: Vinte e cinco anos após a morte de Nicole Brown Simpson, este thriller explora os dias que antecederam o assassinato, com uma nova tese sobre o autor do crime, que se afasta do ex-marido O. J. Simpson e envolve o serial-killer Glen Rogers.

programme.title: Hans van Manen – Moving to Music
programme.desc: Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen (1932) is internationally recognized as one of the grand masters of contemporary ballet. His over 150 ballets all bear his distinct signature, featuring a great clarity in structure, refined simplicity and an aversion to decorative frills.

programme.title: In the Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: This episode of the series 'In the Artist's Workshop' features a masterclass by French classical pianist Philippe Cassard in the works of Claude Debussy.

programme.title: Delibes - Lakmé
programme.desc: Frédéric Chaslin (1963) leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Opéra Royal de Wallonie-Liège in a performance of Léo Delibes’s tragic opera Lakmé (1883). Written to a libretto by Edmond Gondinet and Philippe Gille, the opera is set in nineteenth-century British India and tells the story of Lakmé, who falls in love with Gérald, a British officer.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Piano Concerto No. 1. Op. 1
programme.desc: Piano soloist Boris Berezovsky is accompanied by the Moscow Philharmonic Orchestra under the baton of Alexander Sladkovsky in a performance of Sergei Rachmaninov's Piano Concerto no. 1, Op. 1. Rachmaninov composed his first concerto while studying at the Moscow Conservatory at the age of 18. The concert opens with 'Heavenly Movement', a composition by the young Russian composer Elmir Nizamov (*1986).

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Wolf, De Falla, Poulenc a. o.
programme.desc: Soprano Sophia Burgos (USA, 1991) and pianist Daniel Gerzenberg (Germany, 1991) perform ‘Ich esse nun mein Brod nicht trocken mehr’, ‘Wer rief dich den?’, ‘Schweig’ einmal still, du garst’ger Schwätzer dort!

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 3
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Works by Beethoven and Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: In May and June 2021, Argentinian star pianist Martha Argerich celebrated her 80th birthday performing at Château de Chantilly, France. In this concert, recorded at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, Argerich is joined by three musicians who are particularly close to her heart: cellist Mischa Maisky, violinist Maxim Vengerov, and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï.

programme.title: Beethoven - Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20
programme.desc: The soloists from the Lucerne Festival Orchestra present Ludwig van Beethoven’s Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20, which is scored for clarinet, horn, bassoon, violin, viola, cello and double bass. This 1799 piece achieved great popularity during Beethoven’s lifetime.

programme.title: Who has stolen the Boléro by Maurice Ravel?
programme.desc: One of the world’s most popular pieces of classical music, Maurice Ravel’s Boléro (1928), was no longer copyrighted as of May 1, 2016. Up to then it had made Ravel and his heirs millions. Ravel died in 1937 and left all he owned to his brother Edouard. Edouard’s death in 1960 unleashed a complex legal battle over the rights, involving among others Edouard’s nurse and her husband.

programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Edvard Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16. French pianist Pascal Amoyel features as the soloist. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. It is the composer’s only concerto. The work premiered on April 3, 1869 in Copenhagen, Denmark, with Edmund Neupert as the soloist, and was received enthusiastically.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: In a 2019 performance from the Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven, Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuidnederland for this performance of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7.

programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Symphony No. 3, Op. 78
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Camille Saint-Saëns’ (1835-1921) Symphony No. 3, Op. 78. Geert Bierling stars as soloist on the organ of De Doelen. It was recorded on October 20th, 2018 in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. Saint-Saëns Symphony No. 3 was completed in 1886. It is known as the Organ Symphony since the instrument is used in the second and fourth movement of the work.

programme.title: Beethoven - Last Sonatas, Op. 109, 110 And 111
programme.desc: Beethoven’s last three sonatas – Opus 109, 110 and 111 – explore the intimate meanders of the human soul, from despair to transfiguration. At the time of their composition, Beethoven was already locked in himself by his deafness. This deeply affected his relationship to others and to the world.

programme.title: Prokofiev - Excerpts from Romeo And Julia, Op. 64
programme.desc: The beautiful Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg formed the background for the 1996 edition of the annual Europakonzert of the Berliner Philharmoniker. In honour of the Russian hosts, the concert opened with highlights from Prokofiev's 'Romeo and Juliet', followed by the Cavatina from Rachmaninoff's opera 'Aleko'.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 10
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 10 is an unfinished work left by the composer at his death, representing his ultimate emotional journey from torment and heartbreak to an unreserved acceptance of life and human love.

programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra in Gustav Mahler’s poignant song cycle ‘Das Lied von der Erde’ (The Song of the Earth). Joining him are two of today's leading vocalists: mezzo-soprano Magdalena Kožená and tenor Andrew Staples. Written in the final years of his life, Mahler’s masterpiece contemplates the beauty of life and the sorrow of parting through some of his most personal and beautiful symphonic writing.

programme.title: Beethoven Violin Concerto And Bizet Symphony in C
programme.desc: Young Venezuelan conductor Glass Marcano is a rising star. Having played in various local youth and symphony orchestras as a violinist, her first experience conducting an ensemble followed in 2012. In September 2020, she won the Orchestra Prize at La Maestra Competition – the first orchestra direction contest for women – held in Paris.

programme.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26 (Carnival Scenes from Vienna).

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68, also known as the Pastoral Symphony. Beethoven wrote the work upon completion of his Symphony No. 5. Both symphonies premiered at the same legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No.

programme.title: Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw 2018
programme.desc: Musical critics from North America, Europe, and Russia praise Nalchik-born pianist Misha Fomin for his subtlety of touch and phrasing. He graduated cum laude from the Gnessin’s Russian Academy of Music, Moscow, where he studied with Lina Bulatova, a former student of professor Helen Gnessina and legendary Heinrich Neuhaus, and later continued his musical studies at the Hochschule für Musik “Franz Liszt” in Weimar.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, maestro Jordan presents Beethoven’s final symphony: Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125.

programme.title: Mahler - The Youth Wunderhorn
programme.desc: The Youth Wunderhorn songs are a set of 12 orchestral lieder by Mahler, based on folk poems from the collection by Arnim and Brentano, blending romanticism with folk elements and exploring human experience with authenticity and profound emotional depth. The songs draw from German folk traditions, incorporating themes of nature, love, and soldier life, often with a dramatic or poignant quality.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Fantasie in C, Op. 17 in 1836, revising it prior to publication in 1839.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Les Bains Macabres
programme.desc: French composer Guillaume Connesson (*1970) is building an impressive musical oeuvre, to which he has recently added an opera: 'Les bains macabres'. For this romantic contemporary thriller opera he worked closely with librettist Olivier Bleys (*1970), a successful French author with dozens of novels to his credit.

programme.title: Bacchetti performs Bach, Haydn and Mozart
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti appears both as conductor and soloist in this concert recorded at Teatro Chiabrera in the Italian city of Savona. He is accompanied by I Musici di Parma. On the program are J. S. Bach’s Prelude and Fugue in E major, BWV 878 (The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book II, No. 9), Joseph Haydn's Piano Concerto No. 11 in D major (Hob.

programme.title: Approaching the Maelström
programme.desc: The 2019 documentary ‘Approaching the Maelström’ follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass’s composition ‘A Descent into the Maelström’. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway.

programme.title: Johan de Meij - Symphony No. 1 “Lord of the Rings”
programme.desc: This concert is the result of the collaboration between the “Giuseppe Nicolini,” Conservatory of Piacenza, and the “Giuseppe Verdi,” Conservatory of Milan, as part of the project 'MIlanoPIACEnza ... suonare insieme”. On the program are works by the Dutch conductor and composer Johan de Meij. His Symphony No. 1 for woodwind and brass orchestra is titled “Lord of the Rings” and is based on the famous trilogy by writer J. R. R Tolkien.

programme.title: Schumann - Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13. Composed between 1834-37, the work began as a theme and a set of sixteen variations.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Romeo And Juliet - Fantasy Ouverture
programme.desc: Every year, the Europakonzert is hosted by the Berliner Philharmoniker in a notorious concert hall or on a special location. This years concert is performed at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall in London. The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink starts with Tchaikovsky's Fantasy Overture from 'Roméo et Juliette'. The second piece by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart is his famous Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major K.

programme.title: Mozart Symphony No. 34 And Dvorák Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Antonín Dvorák. Mozart’s Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338 opens the program. Completed in the summer of 1780, this was the last symphony Mozart wrote in Salzburg, where he worked as a court musician.

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 4 BWV 1017
programme.desc: This Sonata for Violin and Harpsichord No. 1 BWV 1014 is the fourth out of the set of sonatas Johann Sebastian Bach composed before 1725, probably during his time as chapel master in Köthen. Presumably, he wrote these sonatas for Prince Leopold and later adapted them for further use in Leipzig.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons (1943-2019) was one of the world’s leading conductors. He served as Music Director of the Oslo Philharmonic from 1979 to 2000, during which time he transformed the orchestra into a front-rank ensemble. Under his leadership, the orchestra toured extensively and became a favorite at major festivals worldwide.

programme.title: Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 8
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 8, also known as the 'Symphony of a Thousand,' is a monumental choral epic composed in 1906 that requires an enormous ensemble of soloists, choruses, and a massive orchestra to perform its vast musical tapestry. The work is a unique and grandiose tribute to love and the spiritual salvation of mankind, drawing from two distinct textual sources to create its sublime effect.

programme.title: Modena - The Belcanto School
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40. Violin soloist is David Radzynski. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in February 2023. Strauss, at the age of 34, sparked outrage when he cast himself as the central figure of his tone poem. Generally agreed to be autobiographical, the work contains more than thirty quotations from Strauss's earlier works.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 5, Op. 73
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker, Daniel Barenboim and Claudio Abbado star at the Europakonzert 1994 in Meiningen, Germany, performing Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 and Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 2. Popularly known as the Emperor Concerto and composed in Vienna between 1809 and 1811, Piano Concerto No. 5 is Beethoven’s last completed piano concerto and often performed by star pianists such as Daniel Barenboim.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93. Beethoven wrote the work in 1812 upon completion of his Symphony No. 7. The composer conducted the February 27, 1814 première at a concert in Vienna that also included a reprise performance of his Symphony No.

programme.title: Jaroussky sings Bach And Telemann
programme.desc: The film Jaroussky sings Bach And Telemann is a portrait of a very special vocalist, and of two exceptional composers. When Philippe Jaroussky - whose angelic voice seems almost timeless, not belonging to any one epoque or decade - sings works by Telemann and Bach, it becomes abundantly clear that the sheer emotional force and the purifying power of their music have not diminished over the centuries.

programme.title: Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: Composed between 1901 and 1902, Mahler's Fifth Symphony marked a significant shift in his compositional style, moving away from vocal elements toward a purely symphonic structure. It's a work of immense scope and emotional depth, known for its rich orchestral textures and intricate counterpoint.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9, Op. 125
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) and Chorus in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The soloists are Iwona Sobotka (soprano), Anna Stephany (mezzo-soprano), Robert Murray (tenor), and Florian Boesch (baritone).

programme.title: Martha Argerich – A Birthday Celebration III
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Lily Maisky and Iddo Bar-Shaï, violinists Tedi Papavrami and Akiko Suwanai, her daughter Lyda Chen-Argerich on viola, and cellist Mischa Maisky.

programme.title: Beethoven-String Quartet No. 6, Op. 18 No. 6
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Holst - The Planets
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam and the Nationaal Vrouwen Jeugdkoor in a performance of Gustav Holst’s The Planets, Op. 32, recorded at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1, Op. 15
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. In this concert at the Lucerne Festival, the celebrated pianist performs the signature piece with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who made his debut here with the orchestra.

programme.title: The Unanswered Ives
programme.desc: “The Unanswered Ives” is the first documentary about American modernist composer Charles Ives (1874-1954). Ives was among the first generation of American composers that achieved international acclaim. Born in 1874, in Danbury, Connecticut, Ives took music lessons at a young age, becoming a church organist at the age of 14.

programme.title: Welser-Möst conducts Farrenc, Ravel And Mussorgsky
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 38, K. 504
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig’s Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek’s Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek’s only symphony – was never performed during the composer’s lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today.

programme.title: Brahms Tragic Overture And Mahler Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Misha Enzovoort
programme.desc: Misha Mengelberg, the forgetting has begun. He is waiting for a taxi he didn’t call to go to a performance that won’t take place. Dutch composer/pianist and grand duke of jazz Misha Mengelberg (1935) has been submerged in the shadow of dementia, ending his life as a musician. At the London jazz club Vortex in 2013 he impressively says his goodbyes to the international stage.

programme.title: Mariken in the Garden of Earthly Delights
programme.desc: The opera ‘Mariken in the Garden of Earthly Delights,’ to music by Calliope Tsoupaki, is based on the miracle play 'Mariken van Nieumeghen' (c. 1515). Over five centuries, this old story hasn’t lost a bit of its power and is unquestionably part of the canon of Dutch culture. In this opera, we follow the curious but vulnerable Mariken on a journey through a dark world.

programme.title: Pé Em Riste - Ep. 38
programme.desc: A jornada analisada de Pé em Riste por um painel que junta os mais polémicos e incisivos adeptos do Benfica, Sporting e Porto.

programme.title: Jornal Da Meia-noite
programme.desc: Cobertura intensiva da atualidade, em direto, com reportagem e análise da atualidade e dos exclusivos com a marca da CMTV.

programme.title: Noite Das Estrelas
programme.desc: Noite das Estrelas é um late show como nunca se fez no País apresentado por Maya que analisam os temas palpitantes do mundo social e cor-de-rosa, com a ajuda de um painel de luxo que conta com Teresa Guilherme, Daniel Nascimento, Adriano Silva Martins, Gisela Serrano e Duarte Siopa.

programme.title: Notícias CM
programme.desc: Síntese das principais notícias, em direto da redação do Correio da Manhã.

programme.title: Pé Em Riste - Ep. 38
programme.desc: A jornada analisada de Pé em Riste por um painel que junta os mais polémicos e incisivos adeptos do Benfica, Sporting e Porto.

programme.title: Falar Global T15 - Ep. 41
programme.desc: Magazine de novas tecnologias, tendências, comportamentos e inovação que marca a sociedade portuguesa conduzido por Suely Costa.

programme.title: Língua Mãe T4 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: No ‘Língua Mãe’, Carlos Alberto Moniz sai em busca dos autores portugueses. programme.desc: Os antiquários procuram uma poltrona com tema ferroviário para uma casa de férias na Cornualha. Têm de encontrar objetos para um bar com tema mágico.

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T15 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Como é que os ilhéus das Hébridas Exteriores usam a energia do pedal para tecer o famoso tweed Harris? E, na Islândia, como é que se prepara tubarão fermentado?

programme.desc: Mike encontra um Lancia Fúlvia de 1972 raro. Ele e Ant têm que arranjar as juntas homocinéticas, um radiador avariado, um painel partido e um sistema de combustível entupido.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T14 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Mike e Ant levam um Datsun 510 de 2 portas de 1972 até ao século XXI. O motor está em boas condições, mas a pintura, a caixa de velocidades e a carroçaria deixam-no ficar mal.

programme.title: Na Rota Do Ouro Com Parker Schnabel T3 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Condições voláteis fora da gigante mina de Porgera leva Parker e a equipa a explorar as vilas próximas. Eles testemunham as técnicas locais ilegais usadas para procurar ouro.

programme.title: Na Rota Do Ouro Com Parker Schnabel T3 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Depois de ter enfrentados os hostis trilhos de Klondike e as hostis florestas da Guiana, Parker Schnabel leva a sua caça ao ouro ao próximo nível na Papua Nova Guiné.

programme.title: Alasca, A Última Fronteira T6 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Na propriedade, Otto e Charlotte continuam a restauração da cabana do estrume - mas estará ele a esforçar-se demasiado e a arriscar magoar a hérnia?

programme.title: Alasca, A Última Fronteira T6 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Constantemente levados ao limite pelos elementos, pelas circunstâncias e uns pelos outros, os Kilchers continuam a trabalhar juntos como família para sustentar o seu rico legado.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T10 - Ep. 2

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T15 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Como se faz o famosos chapéu Borsalino, usado pelo Indiana Jones? E como se faz uma bicicleta dobrável até ao décimo do tamanho de uma bicicleta normal?

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T15 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Como é que fazem a guitarra elétrica mais famosa do mundo, a Fender Stratocaster? E como se faz o caviar de ovas fermentadas suecas da Kalle?

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T15 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Tem estado inclinada há mais de 800 anos - qual é a magia que desafia a gravidade por detrás da Torre de Pizza? E como são feitas as bolachas digestivas de chocolate?

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T15 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Como é que os gregos da antiguidade inventaram o pergaminho com técnicas que ainda se usam hoje? E como se fazem os volantes, o objeto mais rápido do desporto?

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T15 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Como se fazem as canetas mais suaves que não borram ou desaparecem? E como fazem pizza para os soldados na frente de combate?

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T15 - Ep. 8

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T15 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Como é que uma empresa holandesa faz os iates mais rápidos do mundo? E como se fazem os novos fatos espaciais que pesam e custam um quinto dos anteriores?

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T15 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Como se faz o presunto de Parma, o mais famoso do mundo? Como se fazem máquinas de remo e como é feita a icónica sinalética do metro de Londres?

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T15 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Como é que os aviões partem e aterram na praia num dos aeroportos mais velhos do mundo? E como é que se faz à mão o vestido nacional da Baviera, o lederhosen?

programme.title: Como Fazem Isso T11 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Como é que o mantém confortável, entretido e em segurança com os mais recentes assentos de avião? Como é que criam os soutiens com tecnologia aeroespacial para uma elevação extra?

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T4 - Ep. 20
programme.desc: O Dr. Pinball, especialista em jogos de árcade, restaura um raro jogo de basquetebol americano dos anos 40. O artista, Nick, aplica reboco e tinta a um enorme touro vintage.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T6 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard pede a Steve Norman para salvar uma mesa de pau-rosa muito rara e valiosa, com métodos tradicionais de corte de latão.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T6 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Mark Squires repara e reconstrói um jogo de bandidos armados dos anos 60. Ted Edley tem a tarefa de restaurar uma lanterna de boia enferrujada.

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters T9 - Ep. 10

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters T9 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: O marido de uma mulher faleceu antes de terminar a sua cabana para a família. Chase e a equipa juntam-se a alguns amigos verdes para terminar o que ele começou.

programme.title: Mysteries Of The Deep T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Jeremy Wade explora os segredos obscuros de um naufrágio de 150 anos ao largo da costa mexicana. Depois, descobre um «rio que ferve» escondido nas profundezas da Amazónia.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele XL T7 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Waz resiste no seu primeiro dia na selva sozinho, enquanto Steven luta contra a descida da temperatura. Além disso, outra tempestade implacável põe à prova os sobreviventes.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 85
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo Do Destino - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 67
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 28
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 68
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.desc: A história gira em torno de uma garota chamada Azra, que está estudando no exterior, na América, para se tornar cozinheira profissional, assim como seu pai.

programme.title: Segure Minha Mão T1 - Ep. 81
programme.desc: A história gira em torno de uma garota chamada Azra, que está estudando no exterior, na América, para se tornar cozinheira profissional, assim como seu pai.

programme.title: O Jogo Do Destino - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Meu Campeão - Ep. 30
programme.desc: Kafkas, um jovem pugilista promissor, tem sua vida virada de cabeça para baixo com um infeliz incidente que o força a abandonar a carreira e se despedir dos ringues. Anos depois, ele retornará ao ringue por seu filho Günes e ficará por mais um assalto.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 87
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: Episode 6: Herbie Hancock - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American keyboard player and bandleader Herbie Hancock (1940) achieved success as an incisive, harmonically provocative jazz pianist in the 1960s, then went on to gain wide popularity as a leader of electric jazz-rock groups. One of these, Hancock’s band The Headhunters, ushered in a new era of jazz that appealed to a far wider audience, making jazz listeners out of rhythm and blues fans, and vice versa.

programme.title: Trio Corrente - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: Da Pá Virada sessions bring the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: Travellin’ Blues: Big Daddy Wilson
programme.desc: ‘Jazz en Baie’, a whining guitar sound, and the baritone voice of Big Daddy Wilson are the perfect recipe for an emotional and melancholy blues concert. As a young man, Big Daddy Wilson never saw a real blues concert before he walked into a Bremen club as a young soldier. This revelation drove the expatriate to throw himself head over heals into music.

programme.title: Wynton in the South Bank Show
programme.desc: Considered one of the most technically brilliant players in the history of the trumpet, jazz musician Wynton Marsalis is also a master of classical music and a fine composer. Marsalis takes the cameras with him around New York, to his home town of New Orleans, and to his rehearsal studios where he and his assembled band of musicians are seen putting together the album Blood on the Fields.

programme.title: Runtown - La Machine de Moulin Rouge
programme.desc: Enjoy Runtown’s first concert in Paris, where the Nigerian superstar brings many guests to his show. One of the most talented Nigerian afrobeat scenes will make you rediscover his greatest hits. Nigeria is a very creative country when it comes to the music scene. Runtown is no exception. His first single, “Party Like It’s 1980,” paved the way for “Gallardo,” which caught the entire international scene's attention.

programme.title: Forró Series
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed and curated in São Paulo by director and presenter Dani Gurgel and producer and engineer Thiago Rabello, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: Burton Greene - OTO Part III
programme.desc: Legendary free jazz pianist Burton Greene rose to fame in New York City's free jazz scene of the 1960s. Exploring various spontaneous improvisational styles, Greene performs live at Cafe OTO in London, UK.

programme.title: Gonna Be Alright
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: Ray Charles and the Raelettes - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Crossroads: From Blues to Bossa
programme.desc: A two-part documentary, moderated by Dee Dee Bridgewater. Part 1: From Blues to Bossa On the search for the roots and origins of Jazz, we journey into the European and African music traditions and discover the cultural heritages of Jazz from Rio to New Orleans.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Hijaz
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content: take for instance this unusual performance by the multi-ethnic ensemble Hijaz.

programme.title: Sister Cheryl
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Ellington Medley
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Gonzalo Rubalcaba Trio - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1994, Cuban pianist Gonzalo Rubalcaba was one of the artists appearing here.

programme.title: Aretha Franklin: A trip in Paris
programme.desc: Live Recording at the Palais Des Sports from 1977. Aretha Franklin performs songs like ‘Respect’, ‘You make me feel like a natural woman’, ‘La vie en Rose’ and ‘Singing in the Rain’.

programme.title: Medley
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa’: a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo’.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Shayna Steele
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Kyle Eastwood Quintet
programme.desc: Bassist Kyle Eastwood (1968) is an explorer, equally at ease with jazz melodies as with pop songs. In the late 1970s, his father Clint took him to see his first jazz concert - a Count Basie performance. Eastwood Jr. was in awe of the drummer and wanted to play an instrument himself. It so happened he wasn’t so much interested in jazz, preferring rhythm and blues, Motown and Stax records, funk groups, and North African and Indian music.

programme.title: Saluzzi, Mariano And Dauner live in Stuttgart
programme.desc: Dino Saluzzi, one of Argentina's tango music masters, has been building his legacy since the mid-1980s. His accordion-like bandoneon defines Argentina's tango music. Saluzzi has explored many paths—paths along which he has rarely travelled more than once, despite some common threads.

programme.title: Four Pianists - Jazz a Vienne
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2012 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music.

programme.title: Bixiga 70 - BIRD 2019
programme.desc: Stemming from Brazil's São Paulo, Bixiga 70 is an exciting brass and percussion-based instrumental dance ensemble that combines jazz, funk, and Afro-Brazilian music, incorporating elements from dub, reggae, electronics, cumbia, carimbo, Ethio-jazz, and samba. The name Bixiga 70 is taken from a vibrant neighbourhood in downtown São Paulo.

programme.title: Anita Oday Live in Sweden 1963
programme.desc: Anita O’Day?boasts two wonderful concerts from 1963 and 1970 that present the “jazz singer supreme” in impeccable form. O’Day’s horn-based approach to singing is in full effect throughout both shows including stand-out renditions in each show of audience favorites “Tea For Two” and “Sweet Georgia Brown” (both reprised from her triumphant appearance at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Mike Stern And Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat And Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis’ comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation.

programme.title: Al di Meola - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1993, American guitarist Al Di Meola was one of the artists appearing here.

programme.title: View From The Outside
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Benny Goodman Septet - North Sea Jazz Part II
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Boogieball with Anthony Hamilton
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Duke Ellington live at the Concertgebouw Amsterdam
programme.desc: Duke Ellington: Live in '58 features the earliest-known filmed full-length concert by one of the 20th Century's greatest songwriters and bandleaders. Filmed at Amsterdam's famed Concertgebouw, this 80-minute concert features the 16-piece Duke Ellington Orchestra two years after their stunning performance at the 1956 Newport Jazz Festival, which Duke considered his second birth.

programme.title: Smith, Adderley, Brubeck, Mingus - Newport Jazz F.
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Teus Nobel live at the Bimhuis Amsterdam
programme.desc: Teus Nobel is a Dutch trumpet and flugelhorn player. As a little boy, he was inspired by ‘power’ trumpeters such as Maynard Ferguson and Bill Chase. While studying at the conservatory, he played both as jazz player and as a commercial session musician at musicals. After his time at the conservatory, he started playing in the Royal Netherlands Air Force Orchestra, playing march music influenced by pop and jazz.

programme.title: Ode to Miles: Bitches Brew Beyond
programme.desc: For the 40th anniversary of jazz legend Miles Davis' legendary album Bitches Brew, trumpeter Wallace Roney leads a band that revives the master's music. This project is the brainchild of Miles' family (including his son Erin), which is represented by his nephew, drummer Vince Wilburn. This concert at the ancient theater in Vienne, France, is a grand tribute to Miles.

programme.title: Maceo Parker: Jazz à Juan
programme.desc: As a 25-year-old saxophonist, Maceo Parker played in the band of James Brown, but he is also known for his collaborations with George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy Collins' Rubber Band. Maceo has proven his star quality by creating a special chemistry between all the different styles of American black music. As a pioneer in the ‘groove’, he blends funky jazz with roots and blues with gospel. The result?

programme.title: Peter Beets: Chopin meets the Blues
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who was a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Barbara
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Live in London
programme.desc: Legendary performer Tony Bennett made his debut appearance at London's iTunes Fest at the Roundhouse and this stellar performance features the multi-Grammy award winner performing his biggest hits, among them, 'The Best Is Yet To Come,' 'Fly Me to the Moon,' and his signature song 'I Left My Heart in San Francisco.'.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk - Well You Needn't
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: Keith Jarrett - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Lugano Estival Jazz is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1986, American pianist and composer Keith Jarrett is joined by bassist Gary Peacock and drummer Jack DeJohnette at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Portrait of Maria Ana Bobone
programme.desc: Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called ‘Alma Nova’ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, ‘Luz Destino’ and ‘Senhora da Lapa’ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone.

programme.title: Herbie Hancock - Sly
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson’s virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong: Live in Australia
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly!

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians.

programme.title: 29th Street Saxophone Quartet: Estival 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence.

programme.title: Duets: Carla Bley and Steve Swallow in 1988
programme.desc: If any two musicians share a special bond when they perform, it’s pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow. The two have performed in the same bands since the 1960s and have been romantic partners for more than two decades. Watching them perform is the definition of musical telepathy. A glance or a smile?seems to change the feel of the music.

programme.title: Carrie Smith
programme.desc: Veteran American blues and jazz singer Carrie Smith (1925-2012) was often compared to the legendary Bessie Smith, an artist she greatly admired. She was best known in Europe for her powerful, resonant voice, impeccable timing, and the emotional depth she brought to her songs.

programme.title: Michel Camilo Trio - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Montreux
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Gil Evans, Ornette Coleman - Schloss Ansbach
programme.desc: This program presents two concerts from Schloss Ansbach in 1978. The first concert features Gil Evans and his orchestra, consisting of Gil Evans on piano, Steve Lacy on soprano saxophone, Arthur Blythe on alto saxophone, Pit Levin on synthesizers, Earl McIntyre on trombone, Lewis Soloff on trumpet, Geoffrey Berlin on bass and Sue Evans on percussion instruments.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Omar Sosa AfroCubano Quarteto
programme.desc: To call Omar Sosa an Afro-Cuban jazz pianist would only capture part of his true style. Because while he has always kept one foot firmly within the traditions of his native isle, this citizen of the world also shows an insatiable curiosity, tirelessly exploring music from around the world: from the Caribbean to India and from West Africa to the Arab World. Nothing seems to escape his thirst for discovery.

programme.title: Mondriaan Jazz 2017: FORQ
programme.desc: Forq is an instrumental quartet with an aggressive sound and a penchant for sonic exploration. Originally founded by keyboardist?Henry Hey?(David Bowie, Empire of the Sun, and Jeff 'Tain' Watts) and bassist?Michael League?(Grammy-winning founder of Snarky Puppy), Forq is joined by guitarist?Chris McQueen?and drummer?Jason 'JT' Thomas.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Hypnotic Brass Ensemble
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: Chain Reaction
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.title: Jacob Karlzon Trio - Open Waters
programme.desc: Swedish pianist Jacob Karlzon is joined by Danish bassist Morten Ramsbøl and Swedish drummer Rasmus Kihlberg at the Steinway piano factory in Hamburg to present their album ‘Open Waters’. Karlzon, a classically trained pianist who shared a stage with Kenny Wheeler, Norma Winstone, and Billy Cobham keeps the rich tradition of Swedish jazz eclecticism alive.

programme.title: Live in France: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: Jimmy Smith: Live in '69 boasts an incredible 90-minute concert from 1969 filmed in Paris. Working in his classic trio format with longtime guitarist Eddie McFadden and drummer Charlie Crosby, Jimmy shows why he is still the uncontested king of the jazz organ.

programme.title: Billie Holiday
programme.desc: “God Bless The Child”, “Foolin’ Myself”, and “I Loves You, Porgy”: timeless songs that were made classics by the inimitable Billie Holiday. ‘Lady Day’, as her loyal friend and musical partner Lester Young nicknamed her, was a highly original jazz and pop singer. In a career that spanned most of the 1930s, 1940s and 1950s, she displayed an uncanny ability to convey emotion through her voice.

programme.title: Rhoda Scott And La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. 'It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.

programme.title: George Shearing: The South Bank Show
programme.desc: George Shearing, blind since birth, is one of the world's greatest jazz pianists. Filmed on both sides of the Atlantic, this tribute to Shearing showcases the music which took the jazz world by storm.

programme.title: Count Basie and his Orchestra live in Charleroi
programme.desc: Count Basie is one of the most important bandleaders of the swing era. With the exception of a brief period in the early '50s, he led a big band from 1935 until his death almost 50 years later. Basie's orchestra was characterized by a light, swinging rhythm section that he led from the piano, lively ensemble work, and generous soloing. Basie was not a composer like Duke Ellington or an important soloist like Benny Goodman.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who was a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: WCCB: Tina Rupprecht vs. Eri Matsuda T2024 - Ep. 1123
programme.desc: Ffrom Heidelberg, Germany, a championship tripleheader takes place headlined by Tina Rupprecht of Germany and Eri Matsuda of Japan competing for the WBC and WBO Women's Atomweight World Championships. Also on the card will be undefeated World Champion Sumire Yamanaka, also of Japan, defending the IBF Atomweight World Title against Fabiana Bytyqi.

programme.title: Fight Quest T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Episode 10: California, USA - Hosts Jimmy Smith and Doug Anderson learn the Fight Discipline of Kajukenbo and the Martial Art of Hands, Feet and Throws with Masters Charles Gaylord and Greg Harper.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is an interim WBA light welterweight title fight between Erik Morales and Marcos Maidana that gave Maidana a chance to leap back into the boxing title scene, while Morales provided fans with a vintage performance. Also on the card, action from WBO welterweight champ Carlos Quintanta.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T33 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 1 from Tokyo, Japan at the Ryogoku Kokugikan, features Mitakeumi, Takakeisho, Wakatakakage and Takanosho.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights T3 - Ep. 52
programme.desc: This episode features a middleweight battle between Dmitry Priog and Daniel Jacobs that ends in a crushing overhand right, as well as kickboxing, sumo, weapons and more!.

programme.title: Judo for the World T1 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Judo for the World features the best competitors in the sport as they compete in a global tour for an opportunity to vie for the gold in the World Judo Championship. In this episode we see the best Judo from the Abu Dhabi Grand Slam on world Judo day, we speak to double world champion Mayra Aguiar about the unity of the Brazilian judo team, and watch as two world champions battle for gold in the -57kg division.

programme.title: FIGHT SPORTS MMA T1 - Ep. 121
programme.desc: This episode features coverage of mixed martial arts headlined by an incredible middleweight fight that ends with a tapout between Dricus Du Plessis and Rafal Haratyk. Bonus coverage includes a middleweight melee that ends in submission between Mark Hulme and Gordon Roodman and a female strawweight fight that goes the distance between Danella Eliasov and Irene Rivera.

programme.title: Vapeur
programme.desc: Le détective privé Goro est venu à Sakurajima, une île-volcan du sud du Japon, à la recherche d’une personne disparue ou, comme le disent les Japonais, quelqu’un qui s’est « évaporé ». Au cours de son enquête, il croise la route de trois amies : Toshie, Moe et Mayumi. Elles s’intéressent à lui comme à tout ce qui est nouveau sur l’île. Goro semble alors oublier sa mission.

programme.title: Au Bout de l'enquête, la Fin du Crime Parfait
programme.desc: Au bout de l'enquête, la fin du crime parfait ? Ce magazine s'intéresse aux 'Cold case'. programme.title: A l'instinct
programme.desc: Après les évènements de Nantes, le capitaine Téva Royer rencontre la commandante spéciale Oriane Girard. Il l'accompagne désormais dans les affaires singulières et mystérieuses qu'elle est chargée d'élucider. Leur première scène de crime remue de douloureux souvenirs dans le petit village de Saint-Avène.

programme.title: Le Livreur de Noël
programme.desc: Tandis qu’il attend l’arrivée de ses enfants pour fêter Noël, Julien, en CDD dans une entreprise de livraisons est contraint d’accepter un remplacement au dernier moment. Il promet à ses enfants de rentrer avant minuit et les confie à sa fantasque voisine Olga ! Entre une mauvaise fréquentation du passé qui ressurgit et des livraisons inattendues... le père de famille débute une tournée riche en aventures.

programme.title: Un Dimanche à la Campagne
programme.desc: Le rendez-vous de rencontre à la fois détonante et pleine d'émotions présenté par Frédéric Lopez. Chaque dimanche, il reçoit ses invités à la campagne. Quelque part loin du tumulte, ils se retrouvent le temps d’un week-end. Un moment hors du temps pour se rencontrer et pour parler d’amour, d’amitié, de la vie.

programme.title: Naissance des Pieuvres
programme.desc: Réalisé par Céline Sciamma Avec Pauline Acquart, Adèle Haenel, Louise Blachère L'été quand on a 15 ans. Rien à faire si ce n'est regarder le plafond. Elles sont trois : Marie, Anne, Floriane. Dans le secret des vestiaires leurs destins se croisent et le désir surgit. Si les premières fois sont inoubliables c'est parce qu'elles n'ont pas de lois.

programme.title: Katy Perry: the Prismatic world Tour
programme.desc: Capté en 2017 à Sydney Production : A Perry Production Réalisation : Russel Thomas Une performance haute en couleur où la pop, la créativité visuelle et l'énergie de la chanteuse américaine se conjuguent pour offrir un divertissement grand format. The Prismatic World Tour enchaîne les tableaux spectaculaires au fil des plus grands succès de Katy Perry.

programme.title: Martin Solveig aux Vieilles Charrues 2025
programme.desc: Production : Sombrero And Co Réalisation : Samuel Petit À l’occasion de son unique concert en 2025, Martin Solveig a choisi la scène légendaire des Vieilles Charrues pour une performance exceptionnelle. Cette date, unique performance de l'artiste en 2025, marque bien la fin d'un cycle de 30 ans de carrière, que Martin Solveig s'est réjoui de célébrer sur cette scène mythique des Vieilles Charrues.

programme.title: Carte Blanche à Passi
programme.desc: La légende du rap français Passi dynamite 35 ans d'une carrière unique dans sa variété. Du Ministère A.M.E.R à ses aventures solo, de Bisso Na Bisso à Dis l'heure de Zook et aux duos devenus des hits intergénérationnels, c'est un voyage dans une vie qui a posé de nombreuses bases de la musique française actuelle.

programme.title: Moonwalk
programme.desc: Présenté par Oumar Diawara 'Les gens ça leur fait peur de changer, et ça m'a fait peur aussi, et c'est seulement quand tu fais face à tes démons et tes monstres intérieurs que t'es capable de passer à autre chose'. Oumar a rencontré Cœur de Pirate : enfance, succès, engagements, musique. La chanteuse québécoise revient sur son parcours dans Moonwalk.

programme.title: C'est toujours pas Sorcier
programme.desc: La Brigade des sapeurs-pompiers de Paris se rend sur les lieux d'incendies d'immeubles et d'une raffinerie. Il s'agit de comprendre comment se déclarent les incendies et surtout comment les éteindre. A quelle température un solide, un liquide ou un gaz devient-il inflammable ? Pourquoi l'eau éteint-elle certains feux et pas d'autres ? Comment les pompiers se protègent-ils des fortes températures et des flammes ?

programme.title: Versailles est en Fête
programme.desc: Animé par Stéphane Bern Réalisation : François Goetghebeur Direction artistique : Kamel Ouali Programmation : Emmanuel Virot Production : Electron Libre Productions (groupe Mediawan) En co-production avec Opéra Royal / Château de Versailles Spectacles Pour la première fois, le plus célèbre château de France devient le théâtre d’un immense spectacle où patrimoine, musique et création contemporaine dialoguent dans un écrin d’exception.

programme.title: Les Trésors du Paris Haussmannien
programme.desc: Documentaire produit par Martange Production, avec la participation de France Télévisions. 2022. Réalisatrice : Florence Troquereau Présentation : Sophie Jovillard. Décembre 1851 : la France vient de vivre un coup d'État qui restaure le système impérial. S'ouvre alors le Second Empire. Louis Napoléon Bonaparte veut faire de sa capitale la plus belle. En à peine deux décennies, il va mener à bien un ambitieux plan de rénovation.

programme.title: La Réunification des 2 Corées
programme.desc: Création théâtrale : Joël Pommerat Avec Ella Benoit, Saadia Bentaïeb, Yannick Choirat, Philippe Frécon, Ruth Olaizola, Marie Piemontese, Anne Rotger, David Sighicelli, Maxime Tshibangu (et Agnès Berthon) Chef-d’œuvre de Joël Pommerat, La Réunification des deux Corées est une puissante traversée de l’amour, entre réalisme et humour, une radiographie des passions de tous les temps dans une mise en scène inoubliable.

programme.title: Pierre Boulez Dirige Stravinsky - l'oiseau de Feu au louvre
programme.desc: Co-production: Idéale Audience And le Musée du Louvre Réalisation: Andy Sommer Capté au Musée du Louvre de Paris en décembre 2008 Le compositeur et chef d’orchestre Pierre Boulez est particulièrement connu pour ses interprétations raffinées des classiques du XXe siècle en général et de Stravinsky en particulier.

programme.title: Birds on a Wire - le Chant des Oiseaux (À la Philharmonie de...
programme.desc: Réalisation : Jeremiah Production : La Familia Production déléguée : Oléo Films Avec le soutien du Centre national de la musique Le duo formé par Rosemary Standley et Dom La Nena fête ses dix ans avec un mélange de leurs chansons signature et de nouvelles reprises, pour certaines dans une version avec chœur de jeunes filles.

programme.desc: Un film de Gaëlle Le Garrec Une production Jara Prod avec la participation de France Télévisions. 2026 De la graine à la fibre, en passant par la tige, le chanvre est un véritable couteau suisse végétal : on le mange, on le porte… on en fait même des parois isolantes! Alors qu’on semble redécouvrir aujourd’hui ses mille usages, le chanvre a accompagné le développement de l’humanité depuis plus de 10 000 ans.

Un film de Hermine Costa et Ulysse Cailloux Aujourd’hui, un Français sur deux possède un animal de compagnie, avec en tête environ 15 millions de chats et 8 millions de chiens, des membres de la famille à part entière. Le marché est estimé en France à environ 5,8 milliards d’euros, soit plus que celui des jeux vidéo.

programme.desc: Melina insiste para Diana desistir do casamento. Mauro estranha o atraso de sua noiva. Felícia deixa a casa de Totó inconformada com a presença de Clara. Bete e Gerson contam para Melina que Diana sumiu e Fred desconfia do comportamento da esposa.

Graça não gosta de saber que Ana Maria se ofereceu para dar aula na escola de Vera/Niara. Viriato recebe uma convocação do bispo para ir a Natal.

Julieta dá um tapa na cara de Susana.

programme.title: Por Você - Ep. 13

Peixe e seus irmãos tentam voltar para a casa onde moravam com Juli e descobrem que o imóvel tem outro morador. Peixe, Ítalo, Glorinha e Samuca têm suas mochilas furtadas e se abrigam embaixo de um viaduto.

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 38

Gustavo aconselha Nayara a evitar um confronto direto com Jove. Jove deixa claro para Nayara que ama Juma, e dá permissão à ex-namorada para dizer aos seus seguidores que os dois permanecem juntos. Levi sente ciúmes de Muda.
